paragraphs.text: Profit conversion is the central issue: reported revenue momentum is stronger than earnings momentum. The cited company statements identify funding costs and investment alongside the results, but do not quantify their respective contributions. A comparable-scope earnings bridge is needed before attributing the gap to a single cause.

support.quote: Kaspi.kz revenue increased 15% year-over-year to KZT1.1 trillion ($2.3 billion). Adjusted EBITDA increased 5% year-over-year to KZT397 billion ($826 million). Net income was stable at KZT259 billion ($539 million), even with investments in Türkiye and high funding costs in Kazakhstan.

Fintech revenue increased 23% year-over-year to KZT455 billion ($946 million), supported by 18% growth in average net loan portfolio. Adjusted EBITDA increased 6% year-over-year to KZT171 billion ($356 million), with growth continuing to reflect higher funding costs.

Almaty, Kazakhstan, 10 August 2026 – Joint Stock Company Kaspi.kz (“Kaspi.kz”) (Nasdaq:KSPI) today published its unaudited consolidated IFRS financial results for the quarter and first half ended 30 June 2026 (“2Q and 1H 2026”).

paragraphs.text: The e-commerce disclosures distinguish activity growth from monetisation. Purchases, constant-currency merchandise value and value-added-services revenue describe different dimensions of performance; a higher take rate does not by itself establish a larger contribution to group profit. Review their separate effects rather than extrapolating a headline growth rate.

support.quote: e-Commerce continued to be our main growth driver. Constant-currency e-Commerce GMV increased 28% year-over-year to KZT1.3 trillion ($2.6 billion), while purchases increased 33% year-over-year.

We’re also seeing good results growing revenue from value-added services, namely advertising and delivery. During 2Q 2026, constant currency VAS revenue increased 49% year-over-year. As a result, e-Commerce 3P take rate increased 160 bps year-over-year to 16.1%, and e-Commerce revenue grew significantly faster than GMV. During 2Q 2026, e-Commerce revenue increased 35% year-over-year on a constant currency basis to KZT394 billion ($820 million).

paragraphs.text: The restructured-loan stock merits focused credit review. This is a gross carrying amount for a specific subset of loans, not an overall non-performing-loan rate or realized credit losses. Its movement warrants investigation alongside exposure growth, provisioning and recoveries before drawing conclusions about capital or distributions.

support.quote: As at 31 December 2025 and 30 June 2026, the Group’s restructured loans in Stage 3 amounted to the gross carrying amount of KZT 145,302 million and KZT 178,567 million, respectively.

paragraphs.text: How would the proposed dividend fit with credit exposure, provisions, recoveries and regulatory-capital constraints? The source describes a board proposal subject to shareholder approval; what later evidence establishes approval and actual payment, and what cash is available for distribution?
